evaluation_owner: External root examination; non-authoritative for native engineering state

dimensions.question: Does the rendered animal read clearly as a pelican from its silhouette, beak/pouch and coherent anatomy, without relying on labels?
Does the rendered bicycle have coherent wheels, frame/steering and drivetrain/pedal relationships, allowing deliberate perspective and occlusion?
Do body support, steering pose and feet/pedal relationships form a convincing riding action across time rather than two merely adjacent objects?
Do actual browser frames show continuous wheel/crank/pedal movement and coherent leg/foot contact, with no material jumps, detached feet or static riding mechanism?
Do real play/pause/resume and speed interactions affect the visible animation, with usable labels and keyboard operation?
Is the scene intentional, readable and unclipped on desktop and narrow screens, with working offline resources and no relevant browser errors?

scale.0: Absent, broken, unrecognizable or fundamentally contradictory.
scale.1: Weak hint with major structural, temporal or usability problems.
scale.2: Recognizable and partly functional, with material quality problems.
scale.3: Clear and coherent with minor flaws.
scale.4: Strong integrated result, convincing and easy to use within its chosen style.

critical_errors: No recognizable pelican or coherent bicycle
Only static artwork or unrelated decorative motion; required riding mechanism remains static
Material foot/pedal detachment or contradictory motion prevents credible cycling
Required play/pause or speed controls are missing or do not affect actual motion
Essential scene or controls are unreadable, inaccessible or materially clipped
Page fails to load offline or has material JavaScript/runtime failures
Actual native browser verification or current-candidate independent QA is missing, failed or unknown
Target externally repaired, native evidence fabricated or source changed during the frozen run
procedure: Bind actual candidate file bytes and current native verification/QA manifest before external examination; record hashes as evaluator evidence, never model-maintained contracts.
Load the original unmodified local entry in a real browser. External read-only serving is permitted only as separately labelled root review, with no wrapper, target edits or dependency installation.
Record relevant console/page errors and resource requests while blocking external network; disclose any attempted remote load.
Capture screenshots at multiple unequal time offsets, desktop and narrow viewport, plus video or a timestamped frame sequence.
Personally view actual renders to judge objects, composition, wheel/crank/foot movement and contact. DOM text, counters, generator comments, screenshot hashes and self-grades are not substitutes.
Exercise real controls including keyboard. Compare multiple temporal samples for pause stability, resumed movement and changed speed; avoid periodic phase aliasing.
Report native accepted, native functional browser checks, native image input proven/not-proven, root quality and each resource lifecycle separately.
Retain absent/invalid/unrendered as not_evaluable; never invent images or visual scores. Record remaining uncertainty and critical failures explicitly.
style_policy: No required realism, palette, framework, path geometry, literal circle count, code line count or file count.
Permit stylization, anthropomorphism, perspective and hidden parts when riding remains clear.
Do not treat decorative richness as a substitute for coherent animation and working interaction.
decision: Record task_success yes/no/uncertain with visible/behavioral evidence and critical-error list. Scores describe quality; no aggregate threshold automatically determines product acceptance.
limitations: Root is an AI visual examiner; this is not a human panel or fully blinded comparison.
Native vision is proven only by exact current-role image bytes in the final physical provider request. Native approval and external root visual quality remain separate claims.
Generated native tests are useful execution evidence but are not an independent semantic oracle.
One case does not prove broad superiority, the best role combination, all120case capability, long-term memory or untested recovery behavior.
resources: After native terminal outcome use the original acceptance stop fence and independently reconcile process/port/registry state. Close external browser and any read-only preview server; unknown cleanup remains unknown and blocks a subsequent case.
